# Spinner

**Class:** `UltraCanvasSpinner` · **Group:** [Text entry](../Groups/Text-entry.md) · **Header:** [`UltraCanvas/include/UltraCanvasSpinner.h`](../../../UltraCanvas/include/UltraCanvasSpinner.h) · `#include "UltraCanvasSpinner.h"`

**Inherits:** [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md) → `Element`

## What it is for

A number with up/down steppers

## Creating it

Factory functions (the usual way - every element is held in a `std::shared_ptr`):

```cpp
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasSpinner> CreateSpinner( const std::string& identifier, float x, float y, float width, float height);
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasSpinner> CreateIntSpinner( const std::string& identifier, float x, float y, float width, float height, int minVal = 0, int maxVal = 100, int initial = 0, int stepVal = 1);
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasSpinner> CreateDecimalSpinner( const std::string& identifier, float x, float y, float width, float height, double minVal = 0.0, double maxVal = 1.0, double initial = 0.0, double stepVal = 0.1, int decimals = 2);
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasSpinner> CreateListSpinner( const std::string& identifier, float x, float y, float width, float height, const std::vector<std::string>& items =;
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasSpinner> CreateStepper( const std::string& identifier, float x, float y, float width, float height, double minVal = 0, double maxVal = 100, double initial = 0, double stepVal = 1);   // Horizontal stepper: [−] value [+] with buttons flanking the field.
```

Constructors:

```cpp
UltraCanvasSpinner(const std::string& identifier, float x, float y, float w, float h);
UltraCanvasSpinner(const std::string& identifier, float w, float h);
explicit UltraCanvasSpinner(const std::string& identifier);
```

The first string argument is always the element's **identifier**, never its text (see [Core concepts](../Core-Concepts.md#identifiers)).

## Callbacks

Assign a lambda to the member (or call the setter). Capture the element and its parents **raw**, never as a `shared_ptr` - see [Events and callbacks](../Events-and-Callbacks.md#ownership).

| Callback | Signature | When it fires |
|---|---|---|
| `SetFormatter()` | `void SetFormatter(std::function<std::string(double)> fn)` | A custom formatter takes precedence over the built-in numeric/list formatting. It receives the raw value (or list index in List mode). |
| `onValueChanged` | `std::function<void(double)> onValueChanged` | fired on committed change |
| `onValueChanging` | `std::function<void(double)> onValueChanging` | fired on each interactive step |
| `onSelectionChanged` | `std::function<void(int, const std::string&)> onSelectionChanged` | List mode |
| `onEditingFinished` | `std::function<void()> onEditingFinished` | text edit committed / focus lost |
| `onStepsFinished` | `std::function<void(double)> onStepsFinished` | Once when a run of steps ends, with the value it ended on: the arrow button released, the arrow / Page / Home / End key released, the wheel at rest for half a second, or the focus or pointer gone. onValueChanging and onValueChanged still fire on every step; this is how a caller makes a held button one change - one … |

**Inherited callbacks:**

- from [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md): `eventCallback`, `onPopupAboutToClose`, `onPopupClosed`, `onPopupOpened`, `SetEventCallback`

Off, a Decimal spinner keeps any value to its `decimals` places and the buttons still step by `step` from it: a measurement field showing 8.61 that steps by 0.1. |

## Option types in this header

### enum `SpinnerValueType`

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `Integer` | Whole numbers, formatted without decimals |
| `Decimal` | Fixed-precision floating point value |
| `List` | Cycle through an ordered list of string values |

### enum `SpinnerLayout`

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `UpDownRight` | Editable field on the left, stacked ▲/▼ buttons on the right |
| `SidesHorizontal` | Buttons flanking the field: ◀ / − value ▶ / + |
| `FieldOnly` | The field alone, no buttons: typed, or stepped by the arrow keys and the wheel |

### enum `SpinnerButtonGlyph`

Glyph drawn inside the step buttons.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `Triangle` | Filled triangle pointing up/down or left/right |
| `Chevron` | Two-stroke chevron (&gt;, &lt;, ^, v) |
| `PlusMinus` | '+' on the increment button, '−' on the decrement button |
